result.topic_en: The page gives solutions of the Diophantine equations $(aa+bb)ab=(cc+dd)cd$ and $ab(maa+nbb)=cd(mcc+ndd)$, shows rational $a,b$ with $10ab(aa+bb)=53$, and begins another solution of $aa/cc=(p^3-q)/(q^3-p)$.
result.transcription:
$\frac{a}{c}=\frac{mmp}{nnq}$, ideoque $\frac{p}{q}=\Box$, sive $pq=\Box$.
Praeterea vero quadratum esse debet
$\frac{a}{b}=\frac{mmp(mq-np)}{q(n^3q-m^3p)}$, sive $\frac{mq-np}{n^3q-m^3p}=\Box$,
hocque modo omnes erunt quadrata, unde eadem solutio prodit, quae supra est data.

Resolutio succincta aequalitatis $(aa+bb)ab=(cc+dd)cd$.

Sumtis pro $m$ et $n$ numeris quibuscunque capiatur $\frac{f}{g}=\frac{mm+nn}{mm-nn}$; tum vero sumatur
$p=4f^3+fgg-3g^3$, $q=4f^3+fgg+3g^3$ et $s=4f^3-5fgg$,
tum habebitur $a=mp$, $b=ns$, $c=ms$, $d=nq$. Veluti si sumatur $m=3$ et $n=1$, erit $\frac{f}{g}=\frac{5}{4}$, ideoque
$f=5$, $g=4$, hinc $4ff+gg=116$, ergo $p=388$, $q=772$, $s=100$, seu $p=97$, $q=193$, $s=25$, unde
fit $a=291$, $b=25$, $c=75$, $d=193$, hic scilicet numeros $p$, $q$, $s$ per 4 deprimere licuit, quod semper evenit
quando $g$ numerus par.

Duo numeri $a$ et $b$ assignari possunt, ut fiat $10ab(aa+bb)=53$, quod utique in numeris integris fieri
nequit. Hoc autem evenit sumendo $a=\frac{27}{10}$ et $b=\frac{4}{15}$, tum fit $ab=\frac{54}{75}$ et $10ab=\frac{540}{75}=\frac{36}{5}$; tum ob $a=\frac{81}{30}$
et $b=\frac{8}{30}$ erit $aa+bb=\frac{265}{30}$, ideoque $10ab(aa+bb)=53$.

Resolutio hujus formulae $ab(maa+nbb)=cd(mcc+ndd)$.

Posito $b=pc$ et $d=qa$, reperitur $\frac{aa}{cc}=\frac{mq-np^3}{mp-nq^3}$. Posito $p=q(1+z)$ et $\frac{a}{c}=1-5z$, porro $q=\frac{k}{h}$,
ambo numeri $h$ et $k$ arbitrio relinquuntur. Tum sumatur $\frac{f}{g}=\frac{mhh+nkk}{mhh-nkk}$, eritque
$a=h(4f^3-5fgg)$, $b=k(4f^3+fgg+3g^3)$, $c=h(4f^3+fgg-3g^3)$, $d=k(4f^3-5fgg)$.
Cum enim sit $\frac{mhh}{nkk}=\frac{f+g}{f-g}$, erit
$maa+nbb=mn(2ff-gg)(4ff-3gg)(4f^3+fgg-3g^3)$
$mcc+ndd=mn(2ff-gg)(4ff-3gg)(4f^3+fgg+3g^3)$
erit igitur $\frac{ab}{cd}=\frac{4f^3+fgg+3g^3}{4f^3+fgg-3g^3}$ et $\frac{maa+nbb}{mcc+ndd}=\frac{4f^3+fgg-3g^3}{4f^3+fgg+3g^3}$.
Ceterum hic patet, permutatis numeris $h$ et $k$ sumtoque $g$ negativo, litteras $a$ et $b$ abire in $d$ et $c$.

Alia Resolutio formulae $\frac{aa}{cc}=\frac{p^3-q}{q^3-p}$,
pro qua supra posuimus $q=p(1+z)$.

Nunc vero ponamus $q=nn(p-1)+p$, tum enim prodit
$\frac{aa}{cc}=\frac{p^3-p-nn(p-1)}{n^6(p-1)^3+3n^4p(p-1)^2+3nnpp(p-1)+p^3-p}$,
ubi commode per $p-1$ dividitur prodibitque
$\frac{aa}{cc}=\frac{pp+p-nn}{n^6(p-1)^2+3n^4p(p-1)+3nnpp+pp+p}$.
Hoc modo habentur duae formulae ad quadratum reducendae scilicet
$n^6pp+n^6p+n^8$ et $n^6pp+3n^4pp+3nn+pp-(2n^6+3n^4-1)p+n^6$.
Necesse ergo est, ut sit $(nn+1)^3=\Box$, ideoque etiam $nn+1$. Sit igitur $nn+1=mm$ eritque
